license_required.quote: no person shall practice podiatric medicine without a valid existing license to do so

issuing_authority.value: Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
issuing_authority.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

age_minimum.quote: who is at least 21 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: who has not engaged in or is not engaged in any practice or conduct that constitutes grounds for discipline under this Act

degree_required.quote: who is a graduate of an approved college of podiatric medicine and has attained the academic degree of doctor of podiatric medicine (D.P.M.)

required.quote: who has successfully completed a minimum of one year postgraduate training as defined in Section 5 of this Act

duration.quote: a minimum one-year postdoctoral structured and supervised educational experience

exams.name: Examination authorized by the Department
exams.notes: Administered at least 2 times per year; failure to pass within 3 years results in denial
exams.quote: who has successfully completed an examination authorized by the Department

required.quote: complete continuing education at the rate of at least 50 hours per year

hours_per_period.quote: complete continuing education at the rate of at least 50 hours per year

period_years.quote: complete continuing education at the rate of at least 50 hours per year

available.quote: The Department may, in its discretion, license as a podiatric physician without examination on payment of the required fee, an applicant who is a podiatric physician license under the laws of another state or territory, or of another country

requirements.value: Requirements for licensure in the other state or territory must have been substantially equivalent to Illinois requirements at the date of licensure
requirements.quote: if the requirements for licensure of podiatric physicians in the state or territory or country in which the applicant was licensed were, at the date of his or her licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements in force in this State on that date or on the date licensure is sought under this Section

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, including amputations as defined in this Section; the provision of topical and local anesthesia and moderate and deep sedation, as defined by Department rule adopted under the Medical Practice Act of 1987; and vaccination of patients 18 years of age and older in accordance with Section 20.6 upon completion of appropriate training.
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, including amputations as defined in this Section

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot

drug_authority.value: topical and local anesthesia and moderate and deep sedation, as defined by Department rule adopted under the Medical Practice Act of 1987
drug_authority.quote: the provision of topical and local anesthesia and moderate and deep sedation, as defined by Department rule adopted under the Medical Practice Act of 1987

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "Human foot" means the ankle and soft tissue which insert into the foot as well as the foot.

amputation_authorized.quote: "Amputations" means amputations of the human foot, in whole or in part, that are limited to 10 centimeters proximal to the tibial talar articulation.

anesthesia_authority.quote: the provision of topical and local anesthesia and moderate and deep sedation, as defined by Department rule adopted under the Medical Practice Act of 1987

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: "Human foot" means the ankle and soft tissue which insert into the foot as well as the foot.

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: Persons suitably trained and qualified may render, only under the direction of a podiatric physician licensed under this Act, such patient tests and services as diagnostic imaging procedures, laboratory studies and other appropriate patient services connected with comprehensive foot care

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: Persons suitably trained and qualified may render, only under the direction of a podiatric physician licensed under this Act, such patient tests and services

vaccination_authority.quote: vaccination of patients 18 years of age and older in accordance with Section 20.6 upon completion of appropriate training

advanced_practice_nurse_collaboration_au.quote: A podiatric physician in active clinical practice may collaborate with an advanced practice registered nurse in accordance with the requirements of the Nurse Practice Act.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: The Board shall by rule provide for the reporting to it of all instances in which a podiatric physician licensed under this Act who is impaired by reason of age, drug or alcohol abuse or physical or mental impairment, is under supervision and, where appropriate, is in a program of rehabilitation.
